system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: agristack_verify_land_ownership and agristack_check_land_status. For your information, my land_parcel_id is dummy_land_parcel_id_7104, my aadhaar_number is 100020002899.

function.name: agristack_check_land_status
function.description: Checks verification status of a land parcel. Returns land_record_status ('unverified', 'pending_verification', 'verified', 'rejected'). Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate verification. Fails if land_parcel_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier for a land parcel.

function.name: agristack_verify_land_ownership
function.description: Verifies whether the farmer is the owner of a specific land parcel by cross-referencing Aadhaar with state records. Transitions land_record_status to 'pending_verification' then 'verified' or 'rejected'. Requires session_token. Does NOT fetch records — use agristack_fetch_land_records first. Fails if Aadhaar does not match land owner or parcel not found.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier for a land parcel as per state records.
